dct_description_sm: The objective of the Marine Basic Zackenberg program is to contribute to ecosystem research in the High Arctic by conducting (1) basic quantitative documentation of ecosystem structure and processes; (2) baseline studies of intrinsic short-term and long-term variations in ecosystem functions; (3) retrospective analyses of organic and inorganic material to detect past ecosystem changes and (4) experimental studies enabling predictions of ecosystem responses to Global Changes. This dataset aims at testing the hypothesis that climate change will have an impact upon biomass and species composition of phytoplankton and zooplankton. This dataset is produced within the framework of the monitoring program Zackenberg Basic (www.zackenberg.dk), which is coordinated with another monitoring program, Nuuk Basic (www.nuuk-basic.dk). These two programs are extensive cross-disciplinary ecological studies that examine the effect of climate change and variability on terrestrial and marine ecosystems.
dct_title_s: Physico-chemical parameters, biomass and species composition of phytoplankton and zooplankton in northeast Greenland
